task_prompt: Write a function to count the pairs of reverse strings in the given string list. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python-program-to-count-the-pairs-of-reverse-strings/
final_code:
def count_reverse_pairs(test_list):
    return sum(1 for i in range(len(test_list)) for j in range(i+1, len(test_list)) if test_list[i] == test_list[j][::-1])
